extension.description: Install once, then Kodi will offer Black Knight updates automatically. Used for the Captain's boxes and Haley's Fire Stick.
extension.disclaimer: This is a private family repository. After installing Black Knight, enter your own TMDB API key and pair Real-Debrid and Trakt in Settings.
extension.news: 1.0.0 - First repository release. Serves Black Knight 2.7.1 (clean defaults).

extension.summary: Movies and TV from Netflix, Prime, Disney+, Hulu, Max, and more via Real-Debrid
extension.description: Browse content from Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, Hulu, Peacock, Paramount+, Apple TV+, Max, and Tubi â€” auto-populated via TMDB watch providers. Stream via Real-Debrid with Trakt scrobbling and watchlist sync.
extension.news: 2.7.2 - Search Streaming Services: picking a movie or show plays it inside Black Knight (movies go to sources, TV opens seasons). Open in the official app and Where else to watch are on the context menu. Live TV is unchanged.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a TMDB API key and Real-Debrid account.

extension.summary: Browse and play a WD My Cloud OS5 public share link
extension.description: Reads a WD My Cloud OS5 share link (os5.mycloud.com/action/share/...) and lets you browse its folders and stream the videos, with seeking. No account needed, just the link.
extension.news: 1.0.1: Fix .mp4 playback. A small local relay adds the file-size header the WD cloud leaves out, so Kodi can seek to the mp4 index. JPEGs named .MP4 are no longer listed as videos. Kodi 19 listing fallback.
